eco_pote.title: Green Hero: Challenge Time
eco_pote.subtitle: Educational mobile mini-games for Mon Éco Pote
eco_pote.intro: Green Hero: Challenge Time is a collection of fast-paced mobile mini-games developed for the "Mon Éco Pote" association. Players face quick skill-based challenges centered around eco-friendly actions, learning environmental habits through fun gameplay.
eco_pote.highlight_3: Dual role: Gameplay Programmer & Project Lead
eco_pote.project_desc: Mon Éco Pote is an association dedicated to promoting eco-friendly habits. Green Hero: Challenge Time is their flagship mobile game, designed to make environmental awareness fun and accessible through quick, arcade-style mini-games.
eco_pote.minigames_desc: The game features several skill-based challenges, including:
eco_pote.minigame_trash_desc: Sort falling waste into the correct bins as fast as possible before time runs out.
eco_pote.minigame_bike_desc: Pedal furiously to charge a battery and power up devices with clean energy.
eco_pote.minigame_solar_desc: Clean dirty solar panels to maximize energy production before the sun sets.
eco_pote.minigames_more: And several more mini-games to discover...
eco_pote.role_intro: As Gameplay Programmer & Project Lead, I wear two hats on this project:
eco_pote.role_programmer_1: Implementing mini-game mechanics and core gameplay loops
eco_pote.role_programmer_2: Building modular architecture (one script per mini-game)
eco_pote.role_lead_2: Managing tasks and sprints via Jira
eco_pote.role_lead_4: Integrating artist contributions into the pipeline
eco_pote.team_desc: Working with a variable team size requires flexibility and clear communication. I established workflows that adapt to changing availability while maintaining project momentum.
eco_pote.architecture_desc: The project uses a modular architecture where each mini-game is self-contained in its own script. This approach allows team members to work on different mini-games simultaneously without conflicts, and makes it easy to add new games to the collection.
eco_pote.challenge_1_desc: Managing a team that changes size between phases requires flexible planning. I implemented clear documentation and modular task assignments so work can continue smoothly regardless of who's available.
eco_pote.challenge_2_desc: With few artists on the team, I focused on programmer art and placeholder systems that can be easily swapped when final assets arrive. This keeps development moving forward without blocking on visuals.
eco_pote.challenge_3_desc: Ensuring consistent code quality across the team required establishing clear coding guidelines and conducting regular code reviews. This helps maintain a clean, maintainable codebase.
eco_pote.challenge_4_desc: Balancing difficulty curves and accessibility for a wide audience (including children) required iterative testing and careful tuning of game parameters to ensure fun without frustration.
eco_pote.challenge_5_desc: Creating comprehensive technical and design documents ensures knowledge transfer and helps onboard new team members quickly. I established templates and processes for consistent documentation.
eco_pote.status_desc: The project is currently in playable beta with core gameplay implemented. Visual assets are being finalized, and we're iterating on difficulty balancing based on playtesting feedback.
